originalSourceText:
Q.9  A student freezes the pretrained CNN and trains only a new classifier on top of its
        features. Which strategy has been implemented?

      (A) Full fine-tuning

      (B) Partial fine-tuning

      (C) Feature extraction

      (D) Multimodal fusion

       Explanation: Feature extraction trains only the classifier while retaining the pretrained
       feature extractor.
      Refer slide 15 of Lecture 50: Developing An Emotion Engine For Robots
